summary: digest and watch always carry their trial lists (newest, recently_terminated; new, changed, terminated) as arrays, [] when empty; a regen must not restore omitempty on those tags.
reason: Live, digest on 4 of 6 rare terms (alkaptonuria, progeria, aceruloplasminemia, kearns-sayre) lacked recently_terminated, and a no-change watch rerun lacked new, changed and terminated, so consumers needed a per-key guard. Same contract as Trial list keys and similarMatch.Conditions: the key is present and marshals as [] (never null, never absent). newest is fixed for consistency although its empty state is not reachable live (a zero-result digest errors first). Deliberately untouched: the distribution tallies, FHIR arrays, errors and sources. Guarded by TestDigestListKeysAlwaysPresent, TestWatchListKeysAlwaysPresent and TestDigestWatchKeepValues.
validated_outcome: RED on unchanged code: TestDigestListKeysAlwaysPresent and TestWatchListKeysAlwaysPresent FAIL (4 failing subtests), TestDigestWatchKeepValues PASS; GREEN: all PASS. Mutations each fail: re-adding omitempty to recently_terminated (digest test), re-adding omitempty to changed (watch test), watch new back to nil (new = null), digest list builder back to a nil slice (null), terminated trial sent to changed (keep-values test); the phase-key and trial-list-keys tests stay PASS under the omitempty mutation.
